title: the voided-hollow proof never posts to a live bus
intention: test_a_reseal_names_the_tickets_whose_hollow_it_voids seals the same verdict whether or not a live far bus answers, because its seal runs post to a stub bus, never a live one.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: the proof sealed red while akiendelllinux.local:7419 refused connections (cli._announce_seals raised, and its except called emit on the fixture _Tester, which has none) and sealed green minutes later once the bus answered. A red that measures the LAN is a fake failure.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof measures its subject, not the network); Law 3; outline 9.4.2.3.3.
